camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi ModifyInstance --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --ModifyType Upgrade --Parameter.1.Value test --ProductCode rds --InstanceId 'rm-akjhkdsjhfskjfhd' --ProductType rds --ClientToken JAKSJFHFAKJSF --Parameter.1.Code test
description_en: Modifies the configuration of an instance resource. Calling this operation creates an order to modify the instance configuration and automatically completes the payment. This operation does not support configuration changes for ECS or RDS products. To do so, call the product-specific API operation instead
description_zh: 对实例资源配置进行变更。调用接口会创建一个变配实例资源的订单，并自动支付。该接口不支持ECS和RDS 系列产品的变更，请查找对应产品的专有API执行变配

name: ModifyInstance

The code of the module property.

Specify only the module properties that you want to change. For example, if you have two properties, A and B, and you only want to change property A, pass only the information related to property A
fields.help_zh:
第n个模块属性code配置，n的取值范围为（1~100），如有多个模块属性参数，按照n=1,2,3…n的形式拼接多个参数。

只设置需要变更配置的模块属性信息，如A,B两个属性中，只有A需要变更配置，则只传A属性相关即可
